name: Colombian Gold
summary: Colombian Gold is a [[kind:landrace|landrace]] of narrow-leaflet drug cannabis from [[country:CO|Colombia]]'s Caribbean coast, grown around the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta and exported in bulk to the United States during the 1970s boom, when "Santa Marta Gold" became a regional product name. It is a traditional population rather than a bred variety, and which exact seed lot went into early US hybrids is undocumented.

origin.place: Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, Caribbean coast of Colombia

sources.title: Marijuana Boom: The Rise and Fall of Colombia's First Drug Paradise — Lina Britto (2020)
sources.note: Academic history of the 1970s Colombian marijuana boom on the Caribbean coast; includes a chapter on 'Santa Marta Gold'.

sources.title: Genetic evidence for speciation in Cannabis (Cannabaceae) — K.W. Hillig, Genetic Resources and Crop Evolution 52:161–180 (2005)
sources.note: Places Latin American narrow-leafleted drug strains in the indica gene pool; does not name Colombia specifically.
